answer: The beacon opens the gate, the zephyr pays the toll, the copper proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer pays. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof in one sitting. Let every applicant face the same trial of Watchmaker marine chronometer proof struck within the gear room, and let the verdict read as each marine chronometer is a measured beat rate and a master signature. Honest labour runs 17 minutes a proof; the farm needs 649 proofs, which is 11033 minutes it cannot print.
